{{Top|leg}}
'''Emperor-King''' was formerly the title given to the head of state of the [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]]. [[Prrit Qabaq]] was the last Emperor-King; after losing a civil war where he faced his own daughter [[Ikree]], the Nazzar adopted the tenets of the [[Great Structure]] of [[Ulizra]] to form a government around.
